prompt: Create an ornate Art Nouveau stained-glass illustration of a cute golden-and-white hamster enjoying summer vacation by the sea. The hamster sits in the lower center foreground with glossy black eyes, tiny pink nose, rounded ears, soft fur, and small paws holding a translucent turquoise glass bottle with bubbles and water highlights. Surround it with summer plants and seaside objects: exactly 2 large sunflowers on the right side, exactly 3 large morning glory flowers in the lower left and lower center in blue and purple tones, exactly 1 wide straw sun hat with a deep blue ribbon behind the hamster, exactly 1 dangling glass wind chime near the upper right, and exactly 4 small white sailboats on the ocean in the background. The background shows a bright turquoise-blue ocean with foamy waves, distant green coastline, and towering white cumulus clouds under a vivid summer sky. Frame the whole scene inside an intricate stained-glass window composition with arched golden leading lines, circular moonlike glass ornaments, swirling wave motifs, jewel-toned blue, teal, amber, lavender, and cream glass panels, metallic gold outlines, and a thin dark outer border. Use rich hand-painted texture, luminous translucent glass effects, fine decorative linework, warm sunlight, high detail, whimsical storybook charm, and a vertical poster composition. No text, no watermark, no modern objects except the glass bottle.

promptZh: 创作一幅华丽的新艺术风格彩色玻璃插画，描绘一只可爱的金白色仓鼠在海边享受暑假。仓鼠位于前景下方中央，拥有乌黑发亮的眼睛、粉嫩的小鼻子、圆润的耳朵、柔软的毛发，小爪子握着一个带有气泡和水光感的半透明绿松石色玻璃瓶。周围环绕着夏季植物和海滨元素：右侧有 2 朵大向日葵，左下方和下方中央有 3 朵蓝色和紫色的牵牛花，仓鼠身后有一顶带有深蓝色丝带的宽檐草帽，右上角挂着 1 个玻璃风铃，背景海洋上有 4 艘白色小帆船。背景展现了明亮的绿松石色海洋，海浪翻滚，远处是绿色的海岸线，生动的夏日天空下漂浮着高耸的白色积云。整幅场景置于精致的彩色玻璃窗构图中，包含拱形金色铅条、圆形月亮状玻璃装饰、漩涡状波浪图案，以及宝石蓝、青色、琥珀色、薰衣草色和奶油色的玻璃面板，配以金属金边和深色细外框。采用丰富的手绘质感、明亮的半透明玻璃效果、精细的装饰线条、温暖的阳光，细节丰富，充满童话般的魅力，采用竖版海报构图。画面中无文字、无水印，除玻璃瓶外无任何现代物品。
